entries.name: Learn Focused Force Palm via Observe (Ch. 4, or again in Ch. 9)
Observe: Forward Slash
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Swordsmen at the Communal Training Grounds (SE of Hernand) or the Training Camp in Meandering Hills (NE of Hernand). From Chapter I.

entries.name: Observe: Spinning Slash
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Communal Training Grounds or the Meandering Hills Training Camp. From Chapter I.

entries.name: Observe: Unarmed Combat
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Communal Training Grounds, SE of Hernand. From Chapter I.

entries.name: Observe: Charged Shot
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Bowman practicing between rounds of the Lioncrest Manor archery contest, or Blue Fangs at the Pailune archery range after liberating Pailune.

entries.name: Observe: Counter
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Meandering Hills Training Camp, or Hernand Castle Courtyard guards during the Mystical Key quest.

entries.name: Observe: Drop Kick
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Bandits, usually axe-wielders, in Hernand blockaded areas or the Hernand in Chaos questline. From Chapter II.

entries.name: Observe: Nature's Snare
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Apparition at Haunted Hill Ruins, NE of Hernand. Needs Focus first.

entries.name: Observe: Aerial Roll
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Your first fight with the Crowcaller in the Church of Demeniss graveyard.

entries.name: Observe: Clothesline
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Black Bears at any camp. Vilkom Outpost is the nearest early one. Also in Chapter VI and VII battles.

entries.name: Observe: Turning Slash
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Saigord, the Staglord, at Icemoor Castle Ruins (usually around Chapter VII).

entries.name: Observe: Body Slam
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Sir Catfish during the liberation of Vellua (Beyond the Silent Waves questline).

entries.name: Observe: Explosive Evasive Shot
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Bleed Warpike Commander while liberating Fort Warspike (Nemesis' Demise, House Alfonso). After Chapter VI.

entries.name: Observe: Multishot
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Same Bleed Warpike Commander at Fort Warspike.

entries.name: Observe: Double Jump
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Shai on the west side of Pororinm, after you unlock the secret village.

entries.name: Observe: Tornado Kick (Damiane)
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Communal Training Grounds, the Meandering Hills Training Camp, or Blue Fangs at the Pailune Training Grounds after Chapter VII.

entries.name: Observe: Quick Reload (Damiane)
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Bastier Inquisitors in Demeniss. In Chapter VIII, the Inquisitors in the church west of the Demeniss Graveyard stand still while you stay in the no-weapons zone.

entries.name: Observe: Fishing (life skill)
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Fishermen in the river near Wycliffe Mappery, or any fishing dock.

entries.name: Observe: Spraying (life skill)
entries.how: Hold CTRL near them to Observe. Farmers NE of Stonewell Farm.
